periods.time: Pool training day after Ikki's tenth win

name.en: Ikki and Stella's First Kiss at the Pool

periods.location: Public indoor pool near Hagun Academy
periods.summary: Ayase pushes Stella to admit her relationship with Ikki, leading Ikki and Stella to resolve a month of romantic awkwardness and kiss for the first time.
periods.cause: Ikki brings Ayase to the pool for recovery training; Stella tags along out of jealousy and her own desire to be closer to Ikki.
periods.process: Ayase tricks Stella into revealing that Ikki is her boyfriend, then encourages her to ask for affection instead of fearing rejection. Stella and Ikki talk, misunderstand each other as wanting to break up, loudly confess their mutual desire and embarrassment, and flee to a children's pool water-curtain area.
periods.outcome: They both admit they want to kiss and share their first mouth-to-mouth kiss.
periods.aftermath: Their relationship becomes more visibly affectionate, though still secret from most people.
periods.significance: Breaks the stalled romance after vol-01 and shows Ayase's friendly role beyond the sword plot.
